2. generate_proof_of_work_schema — read continuous_evaluation (REST) + continuous_evaluation_mcp (tools)
3. upload_proof_of_work or buffer_proof_of_work → stash/submit

5. Re-fetch schema as proof of work grows

about.heroTitle: An AI Tutor That Listens to You Think
about.heroSubtitle: The best way to learn isn't being told the answer—it's discovering it yourself through the right questions. Uncertain Systems listens to your reasoning and asks questions that reveal gaps you didn't know you had.
about.understandingDesc: We believe the goal of learning is to understand deeply, not to get answers quickly. That's why we never give solutions — only questions.
about.openSourceDesc: Education technology should be accessible to everyone. Uncertain Systems is fully open source — run it yourself, modify it, build on it.
about.audioFirstDesc: Speaking activates different cognitive processes than typing. When you verbalize your reasoning, gaps in understanding become obvious.
about.guidedDesc: Questions that guide you to understanding rather than telling you what to think. The best way to learn is to discover answers yourself.
about.pickTopicDesc: Choose what you want to understand better — math, physics, business concepts, anything.
about.thinkOutLoudDesc: Explain your reasoning verbally. Our AI analyzes your speech in real-time for logical gaps.
about.getQuestionedDesc: Receive targeted guiding questions that reveal what you don't quite understand yet.
about.weListenDesc: ChatGPT answers your questions. Uncertain Systems listens to YOUR answers and finds the holes in your reasoning.
about.audioFirstLearnDesc: Speaking activates different neural pathways than typing. When you verbalize your thinking, gaps become obvious.
about.neverGivesAnswersDesc: We use guided questioning — leading you to understanding through questions, not handing you solutions.
about.useItYourWayDesc: Uncertain Systems adapts to how you learn—at home, in the classroom, or at work.
about.homeschoolDesc: Guide your kids through any subject with AI that asks the right questions.
about.schoolsDesc: Classroom tools that let teachers see how each student thinks.
about.enterpriseDesc: Train teams on products, compliance, and sales through active learning.
about.certificationsDesc: Prepare for AWS, PMP, and other exams by truly understanding the material.
about.whatMakesDifferentDesc: Most AI tools give you answers. We help you find them yourself.
about.watchMeThinkDesc: Real-time problem solving on Uncertain Systems. No scripts, no edits.
about.fullyOpenSourceDesc: Uncertain Systems is released under an open source license. You can self-host it, modify it, and build on it. We believe educational technology should be accessible to everyone.
about.experienceYourselfDesc: Start your first block free. See what guided questioning feels like.
about.faqLanguagesQuestion: What languages does Uncertain Systems support?
about.faqLanguagesAnswer: Uncertain Systems currently supports English only. We're actively working on adding support for Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, and other languages — coming soon!
about.faqTokenAnswer: The $UNSYS token is a Solana-based token that lets you financially support Uncertain Systems and become a Partner. Partners stake tokens and earn revenue share (10-50%) from users they refer. It's our way of aligning incentives with our community. Learn more in the Partner dashboard.
about.faqPartnerQuestion: How does the Partner program work?
about.faqPartnerAnswer: Stake $UNSYS tokens to become a Partner and earn revenue share from your referrals. Bronze (1M tokens) earns 10%, Silver (2M) earns 30%, and Gold (5M) earns 50%. Partners get a unique referral link and can track earnings in their dashboard.
about.faqDifferentQuestion: How is this different from ChatGPT or other AI tutors?
about.faqDifferentAnswer: Most AI tools give you answers when you ask questions. Uncertain Systems flips this: it listens to YOUR answers and asks you questions when it detects gaps in your reasoning. It's the Socratic method, powered by AI.
about.faqFreeAnswer: We offer a free tier with limited Proof-of-Work submissions per month. For higher volume, check out our Individual (from $49/mo) or Pro / Teams plans on the pricing page.
about.faqSubjectsQuestion: Can I use Uncertain Systems for any subject?
about.faqSubjectsAnswer: Yes! Uncertain Systems works for any topic you want to understand better — math, physics, history, business concepts, certification prep, and more. If you can explain it, we can question it.
about.faqLanguages: What languages does Uncertain Systems support?
about.faqPartner: How does the Partner program work?
about.faqDifference: How is this different from ChatGPT or other AI tutors?
about.faqDifferenceAnswer: Most AI tools give you answers when you ask questions. Uncertain Systems flips this: it listens to YOUR answers and asks you questions when it detects gaps in your reasoning. It's the Socratic method, powered by AI.
about.faqSubject: Can I use Uncertain Systems for any subject?
about.faqSubjectAnswer: Yes! Uncertain Systems works for any topic you want to understand better — math, physics, history, business concepts, certification prep, and more. If you can explain it, we can question it.
about.faqAudio: Is my audio recorded or stored?
about.faqAudioAnswer: Audio is processed in real-time for analysis only. We don't store your voice recordings unless you explicitly choose to upload them. See our Privacy Policy for details.
about.storyParagraph1: For seven years, I've solved hard problems live on camera—quantum mechanics, competition math, theoretical physics—with zero preparation. No scripts. Just real-time thinking, mistakes and all.
about.storyParagraph2Part2: , I've done hundreds of hours of streaming and 1-on-1 coaching. Along the way, I noticed something: the students who improved fastest weren't the ones I gave the best explanations to. They were the ones I asked the best questions of.
about.storyParagraph3: Guided questioning — asking questions that expose gaps in understanding — has been the gold standard for teaching for millennia. But it doesn't scale. A great tutor has to listen carefully, detect where reasoning breaks down, and ask precisely the right question at the right moment.
about.storyParagraph4: That's what Uncertain Systems is: an AI that listens to you reason out loud, detects gaps in your understanding, and asks the questions that help you find answers yourself. It never tells you what to think — it helps you think better.

sessionItem.forkDetailBody: You're browsing a shared workspace. Fork your own copy to track progress, run lessons, and edit blocks.
sessionItem.noDescription: No description for this block yet.
sessionItem.chooseMode: How do you want to practice?
sessionItem.ileHelpSummary: A thinking harness with a dialogue partner for the material you're already working on — not a lecture or a generic chat.
sessionItem.ileHelpPoint1: Bring your own context: course notes, work problems, docs, or anything you're trying to learn right now.
sessionItem.ileHelpPoint2: Use Grok, Grokipedia, or any LLM assistant alongside the dialogue when you need lookup, examples, or extra reasoning support.
sessionItem.ileHelpPoint3: Socratic probes guide you — crystallize what you think, then dive into gaps as they surface. The goal is deeper understanding, not finishing a script.
sessionItem.ileProjectHelpSummary: Longer-horizon exercises per chapter — no dialogue bubbles; dual-stack Thoughts (stash + solution).
sessionItem.ileProjectHelpPoint1: Each chapter is a solo exercise you work through with tools (canvas, notebook, thoughts).
sessionItem.ileProjectHelpPoint2: Thoughts tool splits stash (System 1) and solution (System 2); move thoughts between stacks.
sessionItem.ileProjectHelpPoint3: Mark as Done is final for that chapter (PoW only) — no on-screen score or evaluation.
sessionItem.evalHelpSummary: A structured timed dialogue that evaluates skill — not a recorded tutoring session.
sessionItem.evalHelpPoint1: You narrate your reasoning out loud while working the block, following a think-aloud script — explaining decisions, not performing for a camera.
sessionItem.evalHelpPoint2: This measures how you reason against the block's target skills. It is evaluation, not session capture or replay.
sessionItem.evalHelpPoint3: Gaps surface in the score trace with proof of work, so you know what to repair before it matters on the job.
sessionItem.exerciseHelpSummary: A solo timed exercise prompt — solve out loud without a dialogue partner.
sessionItem.exerciseHelpPoint1: One exercise text at the top; no dialogue bubbles.
sessionItem.exerciseHelpPoint2: Speak your solution out loud and submit thoughts as proof of work.
sessionItem.exerciseHelpPoint3: Remove submitted thoughts later — removals are also useful PoW signal.
sessionItem.ileCtaHint: Live dialogue practice — guidance as you work
sessionItem.ileLearningCtaHint: Guided practice with a dialogue partner — no clock
sessionItem.ileProjectCtaHint: Solo exercises per chapter — stash and solution stacks
sessionItem.evalCtaHint: Timed dialogue demonstration of what you know
sessionItem.exerciseCtaHint: Timed solo exercise — speak and submit your solution
sessionItem.blockDetailGuideIntro: Uncertain Systems is built for live thinking and reasoning, not to replace your textbooks, docs, or courses. You practice with tools and a dialogue partner; you bring the substance.
sessionItem.blockDetailGuideSourcesBody: Use Grok, Grokipedia, notebooks, or any references alongside the session. Lookup and practice belong outside the probe. The session captures how you reason with what you find.
sessionItem.blockDetailGuideMaterialsBody: Attach PDFs, notes, and images in the Files tab, and tune each block with custom instructions below. The more context you add, the more targeted practice becomes.
sessionItem.blockDetailGuideHint1: Files tab: add reference material so probes match what you are actually learning.
sessionItem.blockDetailGuideHint2: Custom instructions: steer this block toward your job, exam, or project.
sessionItem.blockDetailGuideHint3: Open-ended practice: think aloud, crystallize speech into thoughts, send or stash them as you work.
sessionItem.blockDetailGuideHint4: Workspace builder: add or reshape blocks when you discover gaps in the plan.
sessionItem.blockDetailGuideHint5: Timed runs: use when you are ready to demonstrate skill, not on the first pass.

workspaceIntegration.mcpWorkflowSteps:
0. list_workspaces / get_learning_progress — orient on workspace_goal and recommended_next_actions
1. generate_proof_of_work_schema — read continuous_evaluation (REST) + continuous_evaluation_mcp (tools)
2. upload_proof_of_work or buffer_proof_of_work → stash/submit
3. lwm_snapshot (LWM Snapshot — sole strategy); optional get_world_model / list_snapshot_history
4. Regenerate schema and skill as proof of work grows — REST and MCP stay in 100% parity

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introBody: Uncertain Systems ("Uncertain Systems", "we", "us", or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use Uncertain Systems and our services.
privacy.personalInfoIntro: We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when you:
privacy.personalInfoTypes: This information may include: email address, username, audio recordings during blocks, EEG brainwave data, uploaded transcripts, and block metadata.
privacy.autoCollectedBody: When you visit our website, we automatically collect certain information about your device, including browser type, IP address, and time zone. We do not use analytics or advertising trackers.
privacy.howWeUseIntro: We use the information we collect to:
privacy.howWeUseItem1: Provide the tutoring experience (audio analysis, probe generation, reports)
privacy.howWeUseItem2: Store and replay your block history
privacy.howWeUseItem3: Personalize probes using your uploaded think-aloud transcripts
privacy.howWeUseItem4: Record and summarize EEG data during blocks
privacy.howWeUseItem6: Respond to your inquiries and support requests
privacy.howWeUseItem7: Improve our platform and AI tutoring quality
privacy.thirdPartyIntro: We share data with the following third-party services, strictly to operate Uncertain Systems:
privacy.thirdPartySupabase: authentication, database, and file storage (audio, EEG, transcripts)
privacy.thirdPartyXai: AI model inference, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, image generation, and file storage for probes, plans, reports, and block artifacts
privacy.thirdPartyStripe: payment processing (we never see or store your card details)
privacy.noSellData: We do not sell your personal information to third parties.
privacy.dataSecurityBody: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information. Audio recordings and EEG data are stored in private, per-user storage buckets. However, no electronic transmission over the Internet or information storage technology can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.
privacy.gdprIntro: If you are a resident of the European Economic Area (EEA), you have certain data protection rights:
privacy.gdprAccessDesc: Request access to your personal data
privacy.gdprErasureDesc: Request deletion of your personal data
privacy.gdprObjectionDesc: Object to processing of your data
privacy.gdprContact: To exercise these rights, please contact us at daniel@uncertain.systems.
privacy.anonymizedDataIntro: With your explicit consent, we collect anonymized think-aloud data from tutoring blocks to build AI training, fine-tuning, and context engineering datasets. This data is used to improve the quality of tutoring and advance research in AI-assisted education.
privacy.whatWeCollectIntro: Depending on your preferences (configurable in your Dashboard), this may include:
privacy.transcriptsOnlyDesc: Anonymized text transcripts of your think-aloud blocks, including reasoning patterns and probe interactions
privacy.transcriptsAudioDesc: In addition to transcripts, anonymized audio recordings that capture speech patterns (pauses, hesitation, tone shifts) — voice fingerprints are never stored or included
privacy.anonymizeItem1: All names, emails, and personally identifiable information are removed
privacy.anonymizeItem2: Block metadata (timestamps, user IDs) is stripped or cryptographically hashed

privacy.yourControlBody: Data sharing is opt-in and disabled by default. You can change your preferences at any time from the "Data & Privacy" tab in your Dashboard. step1.title: Tools & Chapters
step1.body:
Your block is organized as Chapters on a spatial grid — pan, zoom, and place steps where they belong. Open any chapter to work through it with Helios.

The Tools strip gives you Notebook, Canvas, Thought Memory, Grokipedia, and more. Chapters are living documents: you can edit and expand them freely during the session, even while paused.

step2.title: Think aloud, then send
step2.body:
Speak your reasoning out loud while you work. Your transcription stays in the bar until you send or stash it.

Press Enter to send the live transcription to Helios. Press Del to stash speech into the stashed-thoughts pool below. Press 1, 2, or 3 to send from that pool. Press E to edit before sending. Thought Memory keeps every trace — select and resend from there, or bookmark insights.
step2.bodyProject:
Speak your reasoning out loud while you work the chapter exercise. Your transcription stays in the bar until you stash or submit it.

Press Enter to put live speech on the Solution stack. Press Del to stash speech (System 1). Open the Thoughts tool (or use Open Thoughts) to see both stacks — Solution on top, Stash on bottom — and move thoughts between them. There is no Helios dialogue in Project Mode.

step3.title: Depth over speed
step3.body: When you're ready, press Start block. Recording begins and Helios will listen to whatever you send — Enter for the live bar, or a number key for stashed thoughts. Take your time — messy thinking is how real learning surfaces.
step3.bodyProject: When you're ready, press Start block. Recording begins and you work each chapter as an exercise — no Helios conversation bubbles. Use Enter for Solution, Del for Stash, and open the Thoughts tool to manage both stacks. Take your time — messy thinking is how real learning surfaces.
step3.quoteText: Learning is not attained by chance; it must be sought with ardor and attended to with diligence.

step1.title: What you'll do
step1.body:
Think out loud on a timer. Helios listens and asks short follow-up questions.

When time ends, your proof of work is saved.
step1.highlight: Thinking out loud also means reading the question out loud. It’s easier if you imagine you’re explaining this to someone — or recording a live stream for an online audience.

step2.title: How the interface works
step2.body:
Speak — your words appear in the live bar at the bottom.

• Enter — send to Helios
• Del — stash for later
• 1 / 2 / 3 — send a stashed thought
• E — edit before sending

Stay speaking. After 5 seconds of silence, the bar fades and auto-stashes. That lowers session purity. At zero purity, the session is invalidated.

step3.title: Pick your starting focus
step3.body: Choose a starting angle. The timer begins and Helios opens with that topic’s question.
step3.quoteText: The expert in anything was once a beginner who refused to give up.

briefing.intro: Speak into the live bar. Enter sends, Del stashes, 1–3 send from stash. Long silence auto-stashes and lowers session purity.

live.sessionPurityAria: Session purity {purity} of {max}. Auto-stash on long silence lowers purity; at 0 the session ends as impure.

practice.bannerHint: Stop anytime or get invalidated — all PoW is still Practice PoW.
practice.doneBody: Your practice PoW was stored and flagged as Practice PoW — even if you stopped early or purity hit zero. You can practice again anytime, or pick a topic for a scored session.

postSession.resultsHint: Your proof of work is saved. LWM Snapshot is not generated automatically — the workspace owner runs Generate new snapshot in Knowledge, or calls the Snapshot API POST .../lwm-snapshot.
postSession.thankYouBody: Your Proof of Work data has been stored.
postSession.impureBody:
This session was closed because session purity reached zero.

Why: purity tracks continuous think-aloud engagement. Long silence on the live bar fades the transcript and auto-stashes it — each auto-stash (or empty-bar silence after a stash) lowers purity. At zero, the session ends and all Proof of Work from it is stored and flagged as low quality / impure.

How to fix on the next try: keep speaking into the live bar; stash with Del when you pause intentionally; send or promote thoughts before long silences; use Practice First if you want a warm-up without scoring pressure.

Want to try again?

welcome.panelIntro:
Welcome to the Think Aloud Protocol. This is a timed demonstration: you explain what you learned while I listen, then I ask Socratic follow-ups to surface gaps and strengths.

How it works: speak out loud — your transcription accumulates in the bar. Press Enter to send directly, Del to stash into the pool below, or E to edit before sending. I respond under my avatar with one question at a time. Thought Memory keeps every trace for resend or bookmarking.

Session length and keyboard shortcuts are on the right. When time runs out, you'll return to the workspace — open the Performance tab when you're ready for unified scoring.
welcome.callToAction: When you're ready, press Play. The timer starts, and I'll open with a specific question about what you learned here.

welcome.panelIntro:
Welcome to your Integrated Learning Environment. This is a desktop-first workspace for serious practice: you work through chapters on a spatial grid (pan, zoom, place steps where they belong), switch tools from the strip — Notebook, Canvas, Thought Memory, Grokipedia, and more — and face me on the right in a comic-style dialogue.

How it works: load a chapter from the map and think aloud while you work. Your transcription accumulates in the bar until you send or stash it. Press Enter to send directly, Del to stash into the pool below, or E to edit before sending. I respond under my avatar as plain text — not a chat thread. Use Mark done when a chapter is finished.

Thought Memory keeps every trace so you can select, resend, or bookmark insights later. Take your time — depth matters more than speed.
welcome.panelIntroMobile: Welcome to your Integrated Learning Environment. Chapters is your starting view — a grid map of your block plan. Swipe between tools and Helios chat. Think aloud, press Enter to send or Del to stash thoughts, then send from the pool. Tap Mark done on each chapter when you're ready to move on.
welcome.callToAction: When you're ready, press Start block. Recording begins, the chapter map stays on the left, and I'll listen to whatever you send.
